_comment: Several cards tucked at once, ordered by their owner (401.4): the bottom, the top, and a pool order control.

cards.name: Test Ordered Bottom Tuck
cards.oracle_text: Put the cards in your hand on the bottom of your library in any order.

cards.name: Test Ordered Top Tuck
cards.oracle_text: Put the cards in your hand on top of your library in any order.

cards.name: Test Ordered Tuck Of Their Hand
cards.oracle_text: Target opponent puts the cards in their hand on the bottom of their library in any order.
